WITH event_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN corpeventprx IS NULL THEN 'No Event' ELSE corpeventprx END as event_type,
    anlycount,
    (inholdpct - instownpct) as ownership_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    event_type,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount,
    AVG(ownership_gap) as avg_gap
  FROM event_groups
  GROUP BY event_type
),
overall_avg_gap AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gap) as overall_avg_gap
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  gs.event_type,
  gs.avg_anlycount,
  gs.avg_gap,
  gs.avg_gap - oag.overall_avg_gap as gap_minus_overall
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_gap oag
WHERE oag.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gs.event_type
